# Provider fixtures

These files are **synthetic**. They were written by hand from knowledge of the
public Shopify Admin GraphQL and Gmail API documentation. They were not
recorded from a real store or mailbox, and no request has been sent to either
provider. Replace them with recordings from a Shopify development store and a
test mailbox before trusting the adapters (see `docs/review-queue.md`).
All names, IDs and addresses are fictional.
